offering_gestorDocumental.name: Document management with AI
offering_gestorDocumental.tagline: Organize, search and sign documents with OCR and AI indexing
offering_gestorDocumental.description: Custom build or monthly SaaS subscription of "Document management with AI". Buy it as software (we hand over the code) or pay monthly while we host it for you.

basico.name: Basic
basico.description: To validate the idea with a limited scope
basico.idealPara: Small teams getting started with PDFs, Word docs and scans
incluye: Email support Mon–Fri 8AM–5PM Colombia, 24h business response

profesional.name: Professional
profesional.idealPara: SMBs with steady flow and PDFs, Word docs and scans

avanzado.name: Advanced
avanzado.description: Multi-channel with high volume and personalization
avanzado.idealPara: Mid-market companies with high volumes of PDFs, Word docs and scans
incluye: Email + WhatsApp + Slack Connect support, 2h business response

enterprise.name: Enterprise
enterprise.idealPara: Enterprises with compliance and thousands of PDFs, Word docs and scans
incluye: Jira/Zendesk tickets with audit, 1h critical / 4h high / 24h medium

offering_gestorDocumental.costoNote: OCR (~$30–$10,000 USD/mo), storage and LLM are paid by the customer directly to the provider.
